sentences.zh: 还有塞满了鲜奶油的超大型蘑菇。

sentences.en: From Hansel and Gretel,
sentences.zh: 从《汉塞尔和格蕾特》，

sentences.en: to the story of Ulysses tying himself to the mast of his ship,
sentences.zh: 到尤利西斯把自己绑在船桅上的故事，

sentences.en: countless fables and stories have told us about the importance of self-control
sentences.zh: 无数的寓言和故事告诉我们自控力的重要性，

sentences.en: and the dangers of giving in to temptation.
sentences.zh: 以及向诱惑屈服的危险。

sentences.en: These ideas have entered the world of science, too.
sentences.zh: 这些观念也进入了科学界。

sentences.en: Psychologists have explored how temptations shape our minds
sentences.zh: 心理学家们探讨了诱惑如何塑造我们的心智，

sentences.en: and how self-control can mold our lives.
sentences.zh: 以及自控力如何塑造我们的人生。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we explore a crucial and often overlooked ingredient of self-discipline.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将探讨自我纪律中一个至关重要却常被忽视的要素。

sentences.en: We'll also consider when it makes sense to exercise self-discipline
sentences.zh: 我们还将探讨什么时候行使自我纪律是有意义的，

sentences.en: and when it might be better to set it aside.
sentences.zh: 而什么时候把它放在一边可能会更好。

sentences.en: In the early 1970s, a Stanford psychologist named Walter Mischel
sentences.zh: 在二十世纪七十年代初，斯坦福大学一位名叫沃尔特·米歇尔的心理学家

sentences.en: conducted a series of very simple experiments that would become famous around the world.
sentences.zh: 进行了一系列非常简单但在全球闻名的实验。

sentences.en: The subjects in the experiments were children from a nursery school in Palo Alto.
sentences.zh: 实验对象是帕洛阿尔托一家幼儿园的孩子。

sentences.en: Walter Mischel wanted to know,
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·米歇尔想知道，

sentences.en: how can children develop the ability to exercise self-discipline?
sentences.zh: 孩子们如何才能培养出执行自我纪律的能力？

sentences.en: He called the experiment the marshmallow teSt.
sentences.zh: 他把这个实验称为棉花糖实验。

sentences.en: This is how the typical marshmallow test works.
sentences.zh: 典型的棉花糖实验是这样的。

sentences.en: This is psychologist Celeste Kidd,
sentences.zh: 这位是心理学家塞莱斯特·基德，

sentences.en: who works at the University of California, Berkeley,
sentences.zh: 她在加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校工作，

sentences.en: 50 miles up the road from Walter Mischel's old lab.
sentences.zh: 距离沃尔特·米歇尔过去的实验室有五十英里远。

sentences.en: You bring a child into a room.
sentences.zh: 你把一个孩子带进房间。

sentences.en: The child is between the ages of 3 and 5 years old.
sentences.zh: 孩子的年龄在三到五岁之间。

sentences.en: And you offer them a choice.
sentences.zh: 你给他们一个选择。

sentences.en: They can have one marshmallow right now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在就可以得到一颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: Or if they can wait until the researcher leaves the room and then comes back,
sentences.zh: 或者，如果他们能等到研究人员离开房间然后回来，

sentences.en: they're told if they have not touched or tasted the marshmallow,
sentences.zh: 研究人员会告诉他们，如果没有碰过或尝过这颗棉花糖，

sentences.en: then they're going to be given two marshmallows instead.
sentences.zh: 那么他们将转而得到两颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: The researcher leaves the room.
sentences.zh: 研究人员离开房间。

sentences.en: They leave the child alone with the one marshmallow on the table.
sentences.zh: 他们让孩子独自和桌上那颗棉花糖呆在一起。

sentences.en: The child is instructed to stay in the chair.
sentences.zh: 研究人员指示孩子呆在椅子上。

sentences.en: Then the researchers wait to see how long before the child eats the marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 然后研究人员等待观察孩子过多久会吃掉棉花糖。

sentences.en: And the thinking here is that there is a treat right in front of the child.
sentences.zh: 这里的想法是，孩子的正前方就摆着一份诱人的零食。

sentences.en: Presumably the treat is delicious.
sentences.zh: 想必这零食非常美味。

sentences.en: And the child has to make a choice between eating the delicious treat right now
sentences.zh: 而孩子必须在现在就吃掉美味的零食

sentences.en: or waiting to eat the delicious treat and then potentially getting a larger treat in 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 和等待一会再吃、从而可能在十五分钟后得到更多零食之间做出选择。

sentences.en: That is correct.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And when you do this,
sentences.zh: 当你这样做的时候，

sentences.en: there are a lot of spontaneous strategies that emerge while a child is waiting there.
sentences.zh: 孩子在等待的过程中会表现出许多自发的策略。

sentences.en: It's common for kids to do things like to physically cover the marshmallow with their hands
sentences.zh: 孩子们经常会用手把棉花糖物理遮挡起来，

sentences.en: so that they don't see it,
sentences.zh: 这样他们就看不到了，

sentences.en: to try to avoid the temptation of grabbing it and eating it.
sentences.zh: 以此来试图避免抓取并吃掉它的诱惑。

sentences.en: Children will sometimes try to look away from the marshmallow
sentences.zh: 孩子们有时会试图把视线从棉花糖上移开，

sentences.en: so they'll look up at the sky or something like this.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会抬头看天空之类的地方。

sentences.en: They're in a room, so it's not, I guess it's the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 他们在室内，所以我想那是天花板吧。

sentences.en: It's not a sky.
sentences.zh: 不是天空。

sentences.en: Other strategies include trying to distract themselves by doing things like singing
sentences.zh: 其他策略还包括通过唱歌等活动来转移注意力，

sentences.en: or making up a little story.
sentences.zh: 或者编一个小故事。

sentences.en: So the kids pretty quickly, even though these are small kids,
sentences.zh: 所以孩子们很快——尽管他们还很小——

sentences.en: it sounds like the kids pretty quickly understood what was being asked of them,
sentences.zh: 听起来孩子们很快就理解了对他们的要求，

sentences.en: understood why it was difficult to do,
sentences.zh: 理解了为什么这很难做到，

sentences.en: and almost instantly came up with strategies to help them do this difficult thing.
sentences.zh: 并且几乎立刻想出了帮助他们完成这一艰难任务的策略。

sentences.en: They did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I will also say, though, that the strategies that kids between the ages of 3 and 5
sentences.zh: 不过我也要说，三到五岁的孩子

sentences.en: spontaneously come up with don't end up being very effective.
sentences.zh: 自发想出的这些策略最终并不是很有效。

sentences.en: So most of the kids end up eating the marshmallow very quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以大多数孩子最终都会很快吃掉棉花糖。

sentences.en: Usually kids wait about 5 or 6 minutes, something like that.
sentences.zh: 通常孩子们会等大约五到六分钟，差不多这样。

sentences.en: So they're not lasting very long.
sentences.zh: 所以他们坚持不了多久。

sentences.en: Walter Mischel, who died in 2018,
sentences.zh: 于2018年去世的沃尔特·米歇尔

sentences.en: said that children who were able to hold off eating the marshmallow
sentences.zh: 表示，能够忍住不吃棉花糖的孩子

sentences.en: demonstrated a capacity for something he called delayed gratification.
sentences.zh: 展现出了一种他称之为延迟满足的能力。

sentences.en: He sensed it was an important skill in all sorts of domains,
sentences.zh: 他感觉到这在各种领域都是一项重要的技能，

sentences.en: and he wanted to see if he could teach kids strategies
sentences.zh: 他想看看自己是否能教给孩子们一些策略，

sentences.en: to exercise better self-control.
sentences.zh: 让他们能够更好地进行自控。

sentences.en: He started to look for mental hacks that could help everyone,
sentences.zh: 他开始寻找可以帮助所有人——无论是儿童还是成年人——抵御诱惑的心智小技巧。

sentences.en: children and adults, stave off temptation.
sentences.zh: 引入的很多策略都是注意力操纵，

sentences.en: A lot of the strategies that were introduced were attentional manipulation,
sentences.zh: 比如教孩子们去想象诸如未来的奖励之类的东西。

sentences.en: so teaching kids to imagine something like the later reward.
sentences.zh: 想象你以后会得到什么。

sentences.en: So imagine what you're going to get later.
sentences.zh: 他发现，当你引入那些没有突显棉花糖美味的视觉化想象时，

sentences.en: He found that there were longer wait times when you introduced visualizations
sentences.zh: 等待的时间会更长。

sentences.en: that didn't highlight the deliciousness of the marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 例如，把棉花糖想象成一张照片，

sentences.en: So picturing the marshmallow as a picture, for example,
sentences.zh: 想象它周围有一个相框，这样做能让孩子们等待更长时间，

sentences.en: picturing a frame around it was something that caused kids to be able to wait for longer,
sentences.zh: 而强调棉花糖的美味和软糯，

sentences.en: whereas emphasizing the deliciousness, the chewiness of the marshmallow,
sentences.zh: 也就是想象这些，对于帮助孩子们等待并没有帮助。

sentences.en: so imagining that was not helpful in helping kids wait.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，那往往会导致较短的等待时间。

sentences.en: I was like, that tended to result in less long wait times.
sentences.zh: 你是否大致了解沃尔特·米歇尔的想法，

sentences.en: And do you have a sense on Walter Mischel's thinking
sentences.zh: 他为什么认为这种特质会有用，

sentences.en: on why he thought this trait would be useful,
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是在为了得到第二颗棉花糖而等待五分钟这种微不足道的游戏中，

sentences.en: not just in the trivial game of waiting for five minutes to get the second marshmallow,
sentences.zh: 而且在更广泛的生活中也是如此？

sentences.en: but more generally in life?
sentences.zh: 我认为沃尔特·米歇尔的推理在很大程度上是直观的。

sentences.en: I think that Walter Mischel's reasoning was largely intuitive.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们非常着迷于棉花糖实验和相关视频的部分原因，

sentences.en: I think part of why people were very captivated by the marshmallow test and the videos
sentences.zh: 是因为他们能够产生共鸣。

sentences.en: is because they can relate to that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都经历过这样的情况：只要能抵制某些诱惑，

sentences.en: Everybody has been in a circumstance where they have something that would be better later
sentences.zh: 稍后就能得到更好的东西。

sentences.en: if they could just resist some temptation.
sentences.zh: 现在每个人都能对此感同身受。

sentences.en: Now everybody can relate to that.
sentences.zh: 使棉花糖实验从一个针对预备学校幼儿的趣味实验

sentences.en: What transformed the marshmallow test from a fun experiment with cued preschoolers
sentences.zh: 转变为一个对社会和公共政策具有巨大影响的文化现象的，

sentences.en: to a cultural phenomenon with enormous implications for social and public policy
sentences.zh: 是接下来发生的事情。

sentences.en: is what came next.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，沃尔特·米歇尔对最初实验中的孩子们进行了回访。

sentences.en: In the decades that followed, Walter Mischel checked in on the kids from the original experiments.
sentences.zh: 他测量了从他们的健康结果到学业表现的方方面面。

sentences.en: He measured everything from their health outcomes to their academic performance.
sentences.zh: 进行所有这些追踪的意义在于探讨：

sentences.en: The point of all this tracking was to explore whether kids who were better able to resist temptation
sentences.zh: 三岁时更能抵制诱惑的孩子，

sentences.en: at the age of three had different life outcomes than the kids who ate the first marshmallow right away.
sentences.zh: 其人生结果是否与那些立刻吃掉第一颗棉花糖的孩子有所不同。

sentences.en: There were a lot of findings suggesting that a child's ability to wait early in life,
sentences.zh: 有大量研究结果表明，孩子在生命早期的等待能力，

sentences.en: their ability to delay gratification,
sentences.zh: 他们延迟满足的能力，

sentences.en: went on to predict a whole host of positive life outcomes.
sentences.zh: 预示着一系列积极的人生结果。

sentences.en: Ability to delay gratification was associated with lower body fat.
sentences.zh: 延迟满足能力与较低的体脂有关。

sentences.en: So if you're the kind of kid who cannot eat this first marshmallow in the interest of getting two,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是为了得到两颗棉花糖而能够忍住不吃第一颗的那种孩子，

sentences.en: maybe you grow up to be the kind of adult that cannot eat the piece of chocolate cake at a dinner party
sentences.zh: 你长大后可能就会成为那种在晚宴上为了实现自己理想的身材

sentences.en: in the interest of achieving the physique that you want down the road.
sentences.zh: 而能够忍住不吃那块巧克力蛋糕的成年人。

sentences.en: The ability to delay gratification in the marshmallow test specifically was predictive of social things
sentences.zh: 具体在棉花糖实验中表现出的延迟满足能力，能够预测社交方面的情况，

sentences.en: and also bigger, higher stakes outcomes.
sentences.zh: 也能预测更重大、风险更高的结果。

sentences.en: So not abusing drugs was associated with ability to wait for a second marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 例如，不滥用药物与等待第二颗棉花糖的能力有关。

sentences.en: In another follow-up, Walter Mischel found that kids who waited for the second marshmallow had higher SAT scores.
sentences.zh: 在另一项后续研究中，沃尔特·米歇尔发现等待第二颗棉花糖的孩子SAT成绩更高。

sentences.en: Celeste, what was Walter Mischel's hypothesis about why delaying gratification at the age of three or the age of five
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特，沃尔特·米歇尔的假设是什么？为什么三岁或五岁时的延迟满足能力，

sentences.en: could have effects on someone's body mass index or their SAT scores or their career outcomes 15, 20, 25 years down the road?
sentences.zh: 会在十五、二十、二十五年后对某人的身体质量指数、SAT成绩或职业发展产生影响？

sentences.en: The conceptual hypothesis was that self-control is causally responsible for the child's performance on the marshmallow test
sentences.zh: 概念上的假设是，自控力是导致孩子在棉花糖实验中表现优异的根本原因，

sentences.en: and self-control is causally responsible for how well you do on all of these other factors in life.
sentences.zh: 并且自控力也是你在生活中所有其他因素上表现如何的根本原因。

sentences.en: You need self-control to make friends.
sentences.zh: 你需要自控力来交朋友。

sentences.en: You need self-control to do well in school, to do well on your SAT, to avoid jail time, and to stay thin.
sentences.zh: 你需要自控力来在学校取得好成绩、在SAT考试中考好、避免入狱以及保持苗条。

sentences.en: Give me some sense of the impact of this teSt.
sentences.zh: 请让我大致了解一下这个实验的影响。

sentences.en: Not so much specifically on it led to this policy or it led to that policy,
sentences.zh: 与其说它具体导致了这项或那项政策，

sentences.en: but how people came to understand the test at a very broad level,
sentences.zh: 不如说人们如何在非常宏观的层面上理解这个实验，

sentences.en: not just researchers, not just scientists looking at peer-reviewed journals, but ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是研究人员、审阅同行评审期刊的科学家，还有普通人。

sentences.en: This test is commonly referenced in all sorts of pop culture formats.
sentences.zh: 这个实验在各种流行文化形式中经常被引用。

sentences.en: It's on sketch comedy shows and sitcoms and things like this.
sentences.zh: 它出现在滑稽短剧节目、情景喜剧以及诸如此类的节目中。

sentences.en: It's also commonly cited in unexpected places like books on business management and how you should run a company.
sentences.zh: 它还经常出现在意想不到的地方，比如企业管理和如何运营公司的书籍中。

sentences.en: And then from a policy perspective, I think it also was attractive because it offered a sort of magic bullet for how you could combat poverty.
sentences.zh: 然后从政策的角度来看，我认为它也很有吸引力，因为它为如何打击贫困提供了一种类似于灵丹妙药的方法。

sentences.en: It's like how you could combat all of the challenges that face kids that are at the highest risk for the negative life outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你如何应对那些面临负面人生结果最高风险的孩子所面临的所有挑战。

sentences.en: If it's self-control that is causally responsible for these negative life outcomes,
sentences.zh: 如果自控力是导致这些负面人生结果的根本原因，

sentences.en: all we have to do is train up their self-control and things will work out for them.
sentences.zh: 我们所需要做的就是培养他们的自控力，事情就会对他们迎刃而解。

sentences.en: I want to play you a little clip here, Celeste.
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特，我想给你播放一小段视频。

sentences.en: This is Walter Mischel on the Colbert Report.
sentences.zh: 这是沃尔特·米歇尔在《扣扣熊报告》上的访谈。

sentences.en: You think that one who doesn't eat the marshmallow first, you found, were more successful in life?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那个没有先吃棉花糖的人，最后在生活中更成功吗？

sentences.en: The longer kids waited to get the two, generally,
sentences.zh: 孩子们等待吃两块糖的时间越长，总体而言，

sentences.en: the more successful their lives turned out to be if they were consistent in how they continued in self-control over the life course.
sentences.zh: 只要他们在整个人生历程中持续保持自我控制，他们的人生往往就会越成功。

sentences.en: Do we even need the SATs anymore if we've got the marshmallow test?
sentences.zh: 如果我们已经有了棉花糖实验，难道还需要SAT考试吗？

sentences.en: Just get all the kids in the room, the kid who waits for the two marshmallows, right to the Ivy League.
sentences.zh: 只要把所有的孩子召集到房间里，那个能等到两块棉花糖的孩子，直接就能进常春藤盟校。

sentences.en: So you can see how this really captured the popular imagination here, Celeste.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出，这确实抓住了大众的想象力，塞莱斯特。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I somehow hadn't heard that before, but that's bringing back what I remember feeling the first time I heard about the marshmallow teSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知怎么以前没听说过，但这勾起了我第一次听到棉花糖实验时的感受。

sentences.en: Those claims are big.
sentences.zh: 这些说法太夸张了。

sentences.en: The claim that it predicts your future, your ability to achieve the dreams that you want in life.
sentences.zh: 关于它能预测你的未来、预测你实现人生梦想的能力这种说法。

sentences.en: Those are big claiMs.
sentences.zh: 这些都是夸张的说法。

sentences.en: Those are big claims from, you know, a 20-minute experiment.
sentences.zh: 这些夸张的说法竟然源自一个你知道的20分钟的实验。

sentences.en: All of us have grown up hearing stories about the importance of self-control.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人从小到大都听过关于自我控制重要性的故事。

sentences.en: And most of us have seen the effects of self-control and a lack of self-control in our own lives.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人也在自己的生活中见证过自控与缺乏自控带来的影响。

sentences.en: As I write these words, I'm regretting I had an extra-large lunch two hours ago.
sentences.zh: 当我写下这些文字时，我正后悔两个小时前吃了一顿超大份的午餐。

sentences.en: It was delicious at the time, but now I feel uncomfortably full and sluggish.
sentences.zh: 当时吃起来很美味，但现在我撑得难受，而且浑身乏力。

sentences.en: Walter Mischel's marshmallow experiments brought these lessons to life.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·米歇尔的棉花糖实验让这些道理变得生动起来。

sentences.en: They produced data that demonstrated a truism.
sentences.zh: 它们产生的数据证明了一个老生常谈的道理。

sentences.en: Patience is a virtue, and those who practice patience will be rewarded.
sentences.zh: 忍耐是一种美德，践行忍耐的人终将获得回报。

sentences.en: Not only with more marshmallows, but with better health, better careers, better lives.
sentences.zh: 不仅能得到更多的棉花糖，还能收获更好的健康、更好的事业、更好的人生。

sentences.en: As we have seen so often on this show, however, human nature is exceedingly complex.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我们在本节目中经常看到的那样，人性极其复杂。

sentences.en: Sweeping claims about human beings can fail to capture the nuances, the context, the situations where rules break down.
sentences.zh: 关于人类的绝对化论断往往无法捕捉到其中的细微差别、背景以及规则失效的情境。

sentences.en: That's when we come back.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们重回节目的时候。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Before Celeste Kidd became a psychologist, she was a determined high school student living in a small town east of New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 在塞莱斯特·基德成为心理学家之前，她曾是一名坚定的高中生，住在新奥尔良以东的一个小镇里。

sentences.en: Her dream was to graduate high school and attend college across the country in California.
sentences.zh: 她的梦想是高中毕业，然后去远在加利福尼亚的大学读书。

sentences.en: To make this happen, Celeste had to go through her own version of the marshmallow teSt.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这个目标，塞莱斯特不得不经历她自己的“棉花糖实验”。

sentences.en: I'm from a community that is literally on the swamp.
sentences.zh: 我来自一个字面意义上建在沼泽地上的社区。

sentences.en: There's alligators in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 后院里全都是短吻鳄。

sentences.en: It's everything you imagine.
sentences.zh: 正如你想象的那样，应有尽有。

sentences.en: And I really wanted to go to college.
sentences.zh: 我是真的很想去上大学。

sentences.en: I spent a lot of time in high school skipping out on things that my friends were doing in the interest of saving up money for college.
sentences.zh: 我在高中时花了很多时间，不参加朋友们进行的各种活动，为的就是存钱上大学。

sentences.en: One of Celeste's challenges had to do with restricting how much she indulged herself when it came to a particularly delicious New Orleans treat.
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特面临的挑战之一，就是要克制自己对一种特别美味的新奥尔良特色美食的纵容。

sentences.en: Communal eating is very important in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 集体进食在新奥尔良非常重要。

sentences.en: And so it's common for you to be with a group of people and they say, OK, we're all going to order po'boys from my favorite place is Parasols.
sentences.zh: 所以大家经常聚在一起，然后说：“好吧，我们要在我最喜欢的店‘阳伞’买肉汁薯条三明治。”

sentences.en: And they're very delicious sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 那些三明治非常美味。

sentences.en: But when my friends would order, I would always say that I was not hungry.
sentences.zh: 但每当朋友们点餐时，我总是说我不饿。

sentences.en: And actually, I was hungry, especially for po'boys.
sentences.zh: 其实我很饿，特别是对肉汁薯条三明治垂涎欲滴。

sentences.en: I was just eating peanut butter sandwiches on day-old bread because it was cheap.
sentences.zh: 我只是在吃用隔夜面包做的花生酱三明治，因为那样便宜。

sentences.en: I didn't want to spend the money on the po'boys.
sentences.zh: 我不想把钱花在肉汁薯条三明治上。

sentences.en: I didn't want that to make the difference.
sentences.zh: 我不想让这成为改变结果的变数。

sentences.en: And the people who were very close to me who noticed this questioned whether or not I was being too restrictive with myself,
sentences.zh: 那些与我非常亲近、注意到这一点的人会质疑我对自己是不是太苛刻了，

sentences.en: whether I was putting all my hopes too far into the future when it wasn't even clear it was going to work out.
sentences.zh: 质疑我是不是把所有的希望都寄托在遥远的未来，而当时甚至连事情能否成功都还不确定。

sentences.en: And I had moments of wondering if that was true, too.
sentences.zh: 我也曾一度怀疑过这到底是不是真的。

sentences.en: I had a boyfriend who said, like, is it really going to make the difference?
sentences.zh: 我曾有个男朋友说：“这真的会有影响吗？”

sentences.en: Is this $20 going to make the difference between you getting to go to college or not?
sentences.zh: “这20美元难道能决定你能不能上得起大学吗？”

sentences.en: We had a big fight over it, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们为此大吵了一架。

sentences.en: And I said, it's not the $20.
sentences.zh: 我说：“这不是20美元的问题。”

sentences.en: It's the $20 and the $20 and the $20.
sentences.zh: “这是20美元加20美元再加20美元的问题。”

sentences.en: It adds up.
sentences.zh: 积少成多。

sentences.en: It adds up.
sentences.zh: 点滴汇聚。

sentences.en: And I know that it's not this one sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 我知道不是靠这唯一的一次牺牲。

sentences.en: I have to make a lot of them for it to work out.
sentences.zh: 我必须做出很多次这样的牺牲，事情才能成功。

sentences.en: And what if it is?
sentences.zh: 万一是呢？

sentences.en: What if it is this $20 that makes the difference between I can pay the tuition bill or not?
sentences.zh: 万一真的是这20美元决定了我能不能付得起学费呢？

sentences.en: I would be so sad if I was $20 short.
sentences.zh: 如果差20美元而付不起，我会难过死的。

sentences.en: I was like, the closer it is, the more painful it'll be if I don't make it.
sentences.zh: 我想，离目标越近，如果最后没能成功，就会越痛苦。

sentences.en: The most difficult thing Celeste had to give up was the annual Mardi Gras festival.
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特不得不放弃的最困难的事情是一年一度的狂欢节。

sentences.en: Every year in New Orleans, social clubs come together and plan themed parades with elaborately decorated floats and costumes.
sentences.zh: 在新奥尔良，每年社会各界都会联合起来，策划主题游行，并有精心装饰的花车和服饰。

sentences.en: All of the parades are thrown by, they're called crews, which are essentially social clubs that get together and plan for most of the year what the parade theme is going to be,
sentences.zh: 所有的游行都是由所谓的“社团”举办的，这些社团本质上就是聚在一起，花大半年时间筹划游行主题的社会组织，

sentences.en: what each of the floats is going to look like.
sentences.zh: 筹划每一辆花车的外观。

sentences.en: Obviously, that takes a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 显然，这需要花费大量的时间。

sentences.en: It's very intricate work.
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常繁复的工作。

sentences.en: And each parade is a one-in-a-lifetime experience that you're there for or you're not.
sentences.zh: 每一场游行都是一生仅有一次的体验，要么你在现场，要么你就不在。

sentences.en: In her junior year of high school, Celeste was offered a babysitting gig for a bunch of families attending a big party called the Mardi Gras ball.
sentences.zh: 在她读高三的那年，有人请塞莱斯特去给一群参加名为狂欢节舞会的大型派对的家庭做保姆。

sentences.en: But all her friends were going to the parade that night.
sentences.zh: 但她所有的朋友那天晚上都要去看游行。

sentences.en: Celeste wanted desperately to go too.
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特也渴望去。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: Junior year, I was thinking about not having enough for college and it was very important that I get as much as I could.
sentences.zh: 高三那年，我一直在担心上大学的钱不够，对我来说，尽可能多攒点钱非常重要。

sentences.en: So I chose to babysit for the families that were going to the Mardi Gras ball.
sentences.zh: 所以我选择给那些要去参加狂欢节舞会的家庭当保姆。

sentences.en: I love babysitting.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢当保姆。

sentences.en: But sitting there after the kids went to bed that night,
sentences.zh: 但那天晚上等孩子们上床睡觉后，我坐在那里，

sentences.en: I was wondering about what I had missed, as one does, when one skips out on something very exciting.
sentences.zh: 琢磨着自己错过了什么，就像人们错过非常激动人心的活动时常有的那样。

sentences.en: I was feeling a little bit sorry for myself.
sentences.zh: 我当时感到有点同情自己。

sentences.en: But then when the families came back, they had had a really, really good time and they tipped me a few hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 但后来那些家庭回来时，他们玩得非常非常开心，给了我几百美元的小费。

sentences.en: They tipped me enough that I had to check the next morning to make sure that that's the amount that they meant to tip me.
sentences.zh: 他们给的小费如此丰厚，以至于第二天早上我还得再三确认这真的是他们原本打算给的小费金额。

sentences.en: And, yes, I actually don't think it was, but I think it was too, they were graceful and they didn't want to say, like, that was actually an accident.
sentences.zh: 是的，其实我觉着本来可能不是这个数，但我觉得他们既大方又体面，并不想说：“哎呀，其实那是给错了。”

sentences.en: Give that back.
sentences.zh: “把钱还给我。”

sentences.en: They knew I was saving for college.
sentences.zh: 他们知道我在攒钱上大学。

sentences.en: So you eventually get to UC Santa Cruz for your undergraduate studies.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终去了加州大学圣克鲁斯分校读本科。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering when you got there, did you have a sense that the things that you had foregone, that it was worth it to actually be at UC Santa Cruz?
sentences.zh: 我想知道当你到达那里时，你是否觉得你曾经放弃的那些东西，换来能真正身处加州大学圣克鲁斯分校是值得的？

sentences.en: Did it meet your expectations?
sentences.zh: 它符合你的期望吗？

sentences.en: I could not believe when I first arrived at the campus and I saw the giant redwoods.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次到达校园并看到巨大的红杉树时，我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: The campus is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 校园太美了。

sentences.en: I could not believe I had gotten that far and it had worked out.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信自己竟然走到了这一步，而且一切真的成功了。

sentences.en: But then when I started taking the classes and I could take as many as I wanted and there were so many ones that were interesting and I had all of my day to take the classes,
sentences.zh: 但随后当我开始上课，发现我可以随心所欲地选修那么多有趣的课程，并且有一整天的时间来上课时，

sentences.en: I was delighted with my life choices up until that point.
sentences.zh: 我对自己到那个阶段为止的人生选择感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: So that was worth it.
sentences.zh: 所以这是值得的。

sentences.en: That was worth it in the long term.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，这是值得的。

sentences.en: It was painful in the short term.
sentences.zh: 虽然在短期内是痛苦的。

sentences.en: Now, as you listen to Celeste's story, you might conclude she is the poster child for Walter Mischel's marshmallow teSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，当你听完塞莱斯特的故事时，你可能会断定她就是沃尔特·米歇尔棉花糖实验的典型代言人。

sentences.en: Forgo delicious and tempting treats?
sentences.zh: 放弃美味诱人的零食？

sentences.en: Check.
sentences.zh: 符合。

sentences.en: Do the hard thing now in exchange for the better thing tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 现在做艰难的事来换取明天更好的事物？

sentences.en: Check.
sentences.zh: 符合。

sentences.en: Delay gratification and do well in life?
sentences.zh: 延迟满足并在生活中取得好成绩？

sentences.en: Check and check.
sentences.zh: 完全符合。

sentences.en: But not long after she arrived in California, Celeste had an experience that changed the way she thought about self-control.
sentences.zh: 但就在她抵达加州不久后，塞莱斯特经历了一件事，改变了她对自我控制的看法。

sentences.en: She was working at a family emergency center, a place where parents and their children could access resources during difficult times.
sentences.zh: 她当时在一家家庭紧急中心工作，这是一个父母和孩子在困难时期可以获得资源的地方。

sentences.en: Celeste, of course, liked to spend time with kids.
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特当然很喜欢和孩子们在一起。

sentences.en: It's hard to explain what the culture of an emergency family shelter is like.
sentences.zh: 很难向别人解释紧急家庭庇护所的文化是怎样的。

sentences.en: There's a lot of hard stuff that's going on.
sentences.zh: 那里发生了很多艰难的事情。

sentences.en: There's parents that have substance abuse issues.
sentences.zh: 有父母有药物滥用问题的。

sentences.en: There are parents that are incarcerated unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 有父母意料之外被关进监狱的。

sentences.en: Working at an emergency family shelter also means that you are opting into getting sick a whole lot just because people are living in harsher conditions.
sentences.zh: 在紧急家庭庇护所工作也意味着，仅仅因为人们生活在更严酷的环境中，你就很容易经常生病。

sentences.en: So in some senses, you would think that it should be hard.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种意义上，你可能会认为那里的生活应该很艰难。

sentences.en: But working there was a delight because the kids are so cool.
sentences.zh: 但在那里工作却是一种快乐，因为孩子们太酷了。

sentences.en: Celeste had a job tutoring some of the older kids at the shelter.
sentences.zh: 塞莱斯特有一份工作，是辅导庇护所里的一些大一点的孩子。

sentences.en: But she developed a special bond with a preschooler named Jojo.
sentences.zh: 但她和一个名叫乔乔的学龄前儿童建立了一种特殊的羁绊。

sentences.en: One of the first interactions I had with Jojo, she had just told me she had a lollipop.
sentences.zh: 我和乔乔最早的互动之一，是她刚告诉我她有一根棒棒糖。

sentences.en: And just as she was about to put it in her mouth, I was turned towards the kids that I was about to tutor.
sentences.zh: 正当她要把棒棒糖放进嘴里时，我转过身去面对我要辅导的孩子。

sentences.en: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw another kid come bounding down the stairs and grab the lollipop from her hand right before it goes into her mouth.
sentences.zh: 用眼角余光，我看到另一个孩子从楼梯上冲下来，在她把棒棒糖放进嘴里之前一把将它从她手里抢走了。

sentences.en: I had worked in a daycare before, and I was expecting her to burst into tears.
sentences.zh: 我以前在日托中心工作过，我当时预料她会放声大哭。

sentences.en: So I instinctively whipped around, expecting that she would need some comfort for this upsetting thing happening.
sentences.zh: 所以我本能地猛转过身，以为她会需要一些安慰来应对这件令人沮丧的事情。

sentences.en: And to my surprise, she didn't have any reaction at all.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，她没有任何反应。

sentences.en: She continued walking like she had not had a lollipop in her hand at all.
sentences.zh: 她继续往前走，就像手里从来没拿过棒棒糖一样。

sentences.en: Celeste was struck by Jojo's reaction.
sentences.zh: 乔乔的反应让塞莱斯特大受震撼。

sentences.en: The fact she didn't need comforting was worrisome.
sentences.zh: 她不需要安慰这一事实反而令人担忧。

sentences.en: I thought, oh no, that's a sign of something that's gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想，哦不，这是哪里出了问题的信号。

sentences.en: I was like, she should have an emotional reaction.
sentences.zh: 我想，她本该有情绪反应的。

sentences.en: Maybe she has some sort of psychological damage, some emotional stunting or some dissociation or something.
sentences.zh: 也许她有什么心理创伤、情感发育迟缓、解离症状之类的东西。

sentences.en: I was like, maybe there's something wrong with her emotionally, or maybe it's a memory problem.
sentences.zh: 我想，也许她情绪上有什么毛病，或者是个记忆问题。

sentences.en: Maybe she didn't remember that she had the lollipop.
sentences.zh: 也许她不记得自己拿过棒棒糖了。

sentences.en: I thought something was wrong with her.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得她出了什么毛病。

sentences.en: But within a short time of working at the shelter, Celeste realized why Jojo had not been upset.
sentences.zh: 但在庇护所工作没多久，塞莱斯特就明白了为什么乔乔当时没有生气。

sentences.en: I never had a discussion with her about the lollipop because it didn't take long before I figured out that it was me that made the error.
sentences.zh: 我从未和她讨论过棒棒糖的事，因为没过多久我就发现是我弄错了。

sentences.en: It wasn't upsetting because it was very expected.
sentences.zh: 这件事之所以不令人沮丧，是因为它太在意料之中了。

sentences.en: It's very, very common for a bunch of kids that don't have a lot of adult supervision around to steal stuff from each other.
sentences.zh: 对于一群周围没有太多成人监管的孩子来说，互相偷东西是非常非常普遍的现象。

sentences.en: Jojo was little, and she knew she was little.
sentences.zh: 乔乔很小，她也知道自己很小。

sentences.en: So she knew that there was a timer on her putting that lollipop in her mouth, and she took a little too long.
sentences.zh: 所以她知道把棒棒糖放进嘴里是有时间限制的，而她稍微磨蹭了一会儿。

sentences.en: And so it wasn't upsetting to her in part because it wasn't unexpected.
sentences.zh: 因此，她不感到沮丧，部分原因在于这并非意料之外。

sentences.en: It was me that made the reasoning error, and I will remember that forever.
sentences.zh: 是我推理错了，我会永远记住这件事。

sentences.en: Shortly after that moment with Jojo, another incident occurred that made a powerful impression on Celeste.
sentences.zh: 就在与乔乔发生那个瞬间后不久，又发生了一件事，给塞莱斯特留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: I was there for a church group coming and giving out toys to the kids.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个教会团体来给孩子们发玩具，我在现场。

sentences.en: They lined them up.
sentences.zh: 他们把孩子们排成队。

sentences.en: They gave many of them toys, one at a time.
sentences.zh: 他们一次给一个孩子发玩具。

sentences.en: And a common response that the kids at the shelter had to getting these new toys was to immediately break them.
sentences.zh: 庇护所的孩子们拿到这些新玩具后的常见反应就是立刻把它们弄坏。

sentences.en: And the church volunteers that were giving them out, I heard them talking about how these kids, they were not grateful.
sentences.zh: 我听到发玩具的教会志愿者们在议论这些孩子多么不知感恩。

sentences.en: And I mean, I can't even—some of the things that were said were so awful that I've opted not to encode them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我甚至——有些话说得太难听了，我选择不把它记在脑子里。

sentences.en: But the suggestion was that these kids deserve the situation that they're in,
sentences.zh: 但他们的言下之意是，这些孩子落到今天的地步是罪有应得，

sentences.en: that they're the offspring of people that are like this that aren't grateful, and that's why they're here.
sentences.zh: 他们就是这种不知感恩的人的后代，所以才会沦落至此。

sentences.en: And I found that really upsetting because being there and spending time with these kids and understanding what their daily life was like,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很让人心烦，因为身处那里、陪伴这些孩子们并了解他们的日常生活之后，

sentences.en: it was very clear to me why they were breaking the toys.
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要把玩具弄坏，在我看来简直一清二楚。

sentences.en: At this shelter, each family got just one basket that they could use to store things, and it was about the size of a shoebox.
sentences.zh: 在这家庇护所里，每个家庭只能分到一个用来存放在物品的篮子，大约鞋盒那么大。

sentences.en: If you imagine that you are in that situation, you have one shoebox worth of storage for your whole family,
sentences.zh: 如果你想象一下你处在那种境地，你全家所有的储物空间只有一个鞋盒那么大，

sentences.en: what's going in that box?
sentences.zh: 什么东西会放进那个盒子里？

sentences.en: It's like paper documents that you need.
sentences.zh: 那会是你需要的纸质文件之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's like it's IDs.
sentences.zh: 就像是身份证件一样。

sentences.en: It's maybe some hygiene things.
sentences.zh: 也可能是些卫生用品。

sentences.en: It's toothpaste and toothbrushes, and it's medications.
sentences.zh: 有牙膏、牙刷，还有药物。

sentences.en: It's not a big doll.
sentences.zh: 那不是一个大洋娃娃。

sentences.en: A big bulky doll is not going to make it into that box at the end of the day, and these kids knew that.
sentences.zh: 最后，一个又大又笨重的洋娃娃根本塞不进那个盒子，这些孩子心里很清楚。

sentences.en: And so all kids, I think, have thoughts like, what would this doll look like with its head pulled off?
sentences.zh: 所以我想，所有小孩子都会有过这样的想法：如果把这个洋娃娃的头拔掉，会是什么样子？

sentences.en: What would it feel like to pull off the head of this doll?
sentences.zh: 拔掉这个洋娃娃的头会是什么感觉？

sentences.en: And what prevents some kids from pulling off the head of their doll is the expectation that they're going to be able to play with it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 而阻止某些孩子拔掉洋娃娃脑袋的，是他们期待明天还能继续玩它。

sentences.en: And these kids just didn't have that expectation.
sentences.zh: 但这些孩子根本没有这种期待。

sentences.en: So hearing these moralistic judgments of these kids from people that didn't understand, they weren't going to get to play with the doll tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 所以，听到那些不了解情况的人对这些孩子做出道德评判，说他们明天又玩不到洋娃娃了，

sentences.en: so there's no point in preserving it.
sentences.zh: 所以根本没必要好好保护它。

sentences.en: You should play with it hard.
sentences.zh: 你应该狠狠地玩它。

sentences.en: You should make decisions that give you satisfaction right now.
sentences.zh: 你应该做出能让你当下就得到满足的决定。

sentences.en: Now, if you can't count on what's going to be available to you tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 再说了，如果你连明天能得到什么都无法指望，

sentences.en: then to see these kids get judged for them was upsetting and also influential in shaping my understanding of human behavior at large.
sentences.zh: 那么看到这些孩子因此受到评判，不仅令人沮丧，也深刻影响了我对整个人类行为的理解。

sentences.en: The summer after Celeste graduated from college, she decided to take some linguistics courses at Stanford.
sentences.zh: 在 Celeste 大学毕业后的那个夏天，她决定去斯坦福大学修几门语言学课程。

sentences.en: She became friends with a graduate student who was in several of her classes.
sentences.zh: 她和班上的一位研究生交上了朋友。

sentences.en: One day, they took a walk through campus.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他们一起在校园里散步。

sentences.en: So we were walking through the halls and discussing, you know, things like the Stanford Prison Experiment, and the marshmallow task came up.
sentences.zh: 当时我们正走在走廊里，讨论着一些事情，比如斯坦福监狱实验，然后就聊到了棉花糖实验。

sentences.en: And I had never heard of it before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听说过这个实验。

sentences.en: He was surprised I hadn't heard of it before.
sentences.zh: 他很惊讶我以前没听说过。

sentences.en: And he explained that the marshmallow test as being something that you could administer to a kid early in life that could tell you whether or not they were going to achieve great things.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，棉花糖实验是一种在人生的早期阶段可以对小孩子进行的测试，能告诉你他们未来是否能取得伟大成就。

sentences.en: He described it as a test where you give kids a choice, a very simple choice, between one marshmallow now or if they can wait for the researcher to leave and then come back,
sentences.zh: 他形容这是一个给孩子提供选择的测试，一个非常简单的选择：要么现在吃一颗棉花糖，或者如果他们能等研究人员离开然后再回来，

sentences.en: then they can have two marshmallows if they don't eat the first marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 只要他们不吃第一颗棉花糖，就能得到两颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: My response to that initially was thinking, oh, no, I was thinking about Jojo.
sentences.zh: 我当时的第一反应是，哦，不，我想到了 Jojo。

sentences.en: I was thinking about the other kids at the shelter.
sentences.zh: 我想到了收容所里的其他孩子。

sentences.en: And the first place my head went is knowing that these kids I was working with would eat that first marshmallow right away.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里闪过的第一个念头是，我知道我接触过的这些孩子一定会马上吃掉第一颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: I don't think I'd even be able to get my hand up.
sentences.zh: 我估计自己连手都来不及举起来。

sentences.en: And that made me sad because I was there trying to help them avoid all of these negative outcomes he was saying were predicted by waiting for that second marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到难过，因为我当时正在那里努力帮助他们避免他所说的那种因等待第二颗棉花糖而能预测到的种种消极结果。

sentences.en: Celeste was training to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: Celeste 正在接受心理学培训。

sentences.en: Her experience at the shelter prompted her to ask herself a provocative question.
sentences.zh: 她在收容所的经历促使她问了自己一个发人深省的问题。

sentences.en: Was it possible that Walter Mischel, one of the giants in the field of psychology, had missed something very, very important?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能，作为心理学界泰斗之一的沃尔特·米歇尔（Walter Mischel），漏掉了一些非常非常重要的东西？

sentences.en: One of the core ideas in social psychology is that the social and the psychological are inextricably tied up with one another.
sentences.zh: 社会心理学的核心理念之一，就是社会与心理是密不可分的。

sentences.en: We think we are the captains of our ships and the masters of our own destiny.
sentences.zh: 我们认为自己是命运之舟的船长和自己命运的主宰。

sentences.en: We think we choose to be good or bad when confronted by an ethical situation.
sentences.zh: 我们认为在面对道德抉择时，我们可以选择做好人还是坏人。

sentences.en: Now, there is certainly truth in that.
sentences.zh: 当然，这有一定的道理。

sentences.en: Our thoughts and preferences and choices do shape our behavior in powerful ways.
sentences.zh: 我们的思想、偏好和选择确实在很大程度上塑造了我们的行为。

sentences.en: But what most of us underestimate is the extent to which the social world shapes the thoughts inside our heads.
sentences.zh: 但我们大多数人都低估了社会世界塑造我们内心思想的程度。

sentences.en: Walter Mischel's study, looking at the kids of well-to-do families at Stanford,
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·米歇尔研究斯坦福大学富裕家庭儿童的研究，

sentences.en: was being used to explain the behavior of kids growing up in very different contexts.
sentences.zh: 却被用来解释那些在截然不同的环境中长大的孩子的行为。

sentences.en: Was that fair?
sentences.zh: 这公平吗？

sentences.en: Even more importantly, was that accurate?
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，这准确吗？

sentences.en: The crux of the marshmallow test interpretation that is most popular, which is that self-control is causally responsible for your success or failure to achieve success in life,
sentences.zh: 棉花糖实验最流行的解释的核心，即自控力是你在生活中取得成功或失败的决定性原因，

sentences.en: hinges on the individual and whether the individual has a particular ability or not.
sentences.zh: 取决于个体本身，以及该个体是否具备某种特定的能力。

sentences.en: And if they don't have a particular ability, the implication is they're not going to do well in life.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不具备这种特定的能力，其暗示的含义就是他们在生活中将一事无成。

sentences.en: And also there's an implication that it's their fault.
sentences.zh: 此外，这也暗示着这是他们自己的错。

sentences.en: If they were a different way, they would deserve to do well.
sentences.zh: 如果他们换一种方式，他们就配得上成功。

sentences.en: If they are not that way, they get what they get.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不是那样的人，他们就只能逆来顺受。

sentences.en: I recognize that there was an alternative hypothesis that I thought there was good evidence for even in Walter Mischel's own data.
sentences.zh: 我意识到还有一个替代假设，而且我认为即使在沃尔特·米歇尔自己的数据中，也有很好的证据支持这个假设。

sentences.en: And the alternative hypothesis is that it's not that marshmallow test is measuring self-control and self-control is causally responsible for the long-term outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这个替代假设是：棉花糖实验测量的并非自控力，且自控力也并非长期结果的根本原因。

sentences.en: The alternative is what the marshmallow test is testing is a child's expectations about how stable and reliable the world is.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能是，棉花糖实验测试的是孩子对世界有多稳定、多可靠的预期。

sentences.en: Put another way, your ability to delay gratification in the marshmallow test doesn't just depend on your capacity for self-control.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你在棉花糖实验中延迟满足的能力，不仅仅取决于你的自控能力。

sentences.en: It depends on whether you believe there really is a second marshmallow waiting for you if you hold off eating the firSt.
sentences.zh: 它还取决于你是否相信，只要你忍住不吃第一颗，真的会有第二颗棉花糖在等你。

sentences.en: As Celeste pursued a Ph.D.
sentences.zh: 在 Celeste 前往罗彻斯特大学攻读博士学位期间，

sentences.en: at the University of Rochester, she designed a marshmallow test of her own.
sentences.zh: 她设计了自己的棉花糖实验。

sentences.en: We've recruited three- to five-year-old kids, and then we randomly assigned them to one of two conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们招募了三到五岁的儿童，然后随机将他们分配到两种条件之一。

sentences.en: They were either assigned to the reliable condition or the unreliable condition.
sentences.zh: 他们要么被分到可靠组，要么被分到不可靠组。

sentences.en: And in advance of them doing the marshmallow test, we gave them an experience,
sentences.zh: 在他们做棉花糖实验之前，我们让他们体验了一番，

sentences.en: a set of evidence about whether or not they could count on future promised rewards being delivered.
sentences.zh: 提供了一系列证据，让他们了解自己是否可以指望未来承诺的奖励能够兑现。

sentences.en: Celeste and her colleague, Holly Palmieri, told the kids they would be doing an art project.
sentences.zh: Celeste 和她的同事霍莉·帕尔米耶里（Holly Palmieri）告诉孩子们，他们要做一个美术项目。

sentences.en: They could choose to use some regular crayons and begin that project immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们可以选择使用一些普通的蜡笔并立即开始这个项目。

sentences.en: But if they waited a few minutes, Holly would run out and come back with markers and some fancy art supplies.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们等上几分钟，霍莉就会跑出去，带回马克笔和一些精美的美术用品。

sentences.en: When we presented kids with this choice, just like in the marshmallow test,
sentences.zh: 当我们把这个选择摆在孩子们面前时，就像在棉花糖实验中一样，

sentences.en: kids always chose that they would like the second bigger set of art supplies instead.
sentences.zh: 孩子们总是选择他们想要第二套更大的美术用品。

sentences.en: Holly then left them alone in the room under the premise that she was going to get the bigger set of art supplies instead.
sentences.zh: 随后，霍莉以去取更大一套美术用品为由，把他们独自留在房间里。

sentences.en: And then whether or not she came in with them depended upon the condition that the child was assigned to.
sentences.zh: 至于她之后有没有拿着东西进来，则取决于孩子被分配到的组别。

sentences.en: For kids assigned to the reliable condition, Holly reappeared in a few minutes with the nicer art supplies.
sentences.zh: 对于被分到可靠组的孩子，霍莉在几分钟后带着更好的美术用品重新出现了。

sentences.en: The kids received the lesson that waiting did produce good things.
sentences.zh: 孩子们得到的教训是，等待确实会有好结果。

sentences.en: But for the kids in the unreliable group?
sentences.zh: 但对于不可靠组的孩子呢？

sentences.en: Holly would leave the room and then when she would come back, she would apologize to the kid and say,
sentences.zh: 霍莉会离开房间，等她回来时，她会向孩子道歉并说道：

sentences.en: I'm very sorry.
sentences.zh: 非常抱歉。

sentences.en: I thought I had a big set of art supplies, but it turns out I don't.
sentences.zh: 我以为我有一大套美术用品，但结果并没有。

sentences.en: But let me help you use these crayons instead.
sentences.zh: 不过让我来帮你们用这些蜡笔吧。

sentences.en: And she would help them open the container to get out the crayons and use that art supply.
sentences.zh: 然后她会帮他们打开容器取出蜡笔，并使用那些美术用品。

sentences.en: And conceptually, what were you trying to do here, Celeste,
sentences.zh: 从概念上讲，Celeste，你在这里究竟想做什么，

sentences.en: with these two conditions of the kids who basically waited for the better art supplies and got it
sentences.zh: 针对这两组孩子：一组是基本上等到了更好的美术用品并得到了它的人，

sentences.en: and the kids who waited for the better art supplies and didn't get it?
sentences.zh: 另一组是等了更好的美术用品却没有得到它的人？

sentences.en: Conceptually, we wanted children to generate different expectations
sentences.zh: 从概念上讲，我们希望儿童产生不同的预期，

sentences.en: depending upon what they had experienced in this specific context.
sentences.zh: 这取决于他们在这个特定语境中所经历的一切。

sentences.en: So we wanted the kids in the reliable condition to generate the expectation that if I wait, it is worth it, it will pay off.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望可靠组的孩子产生这样的预期：如果我等待，这是值得的，会有回报的。

sentences.en: And we wanted kids in the unreliable condition to have the expectation that if I wait, it is not worth it, it will not pay off.
sentences.zh: 而我们希望不可靠组的孩子产生这样的预期：如果我等待，这是不值得的，不会有回报的。

sentences.en: So that we could tell what the impact of expectations was on the marshmallow test that we did after the art project task.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就可以看出，在美术项目任务之后我们所做的棉花糖实验中，预期的影响是什么。

sentences.en: The marshmallow test was part two of the study.
sentences.zh: 棉花糖实验是该研究的第二部分。

sentences.en: After the kids finished their art project, Holly announced that it was snack time.
sentences.zh: 在孩子们完成美术项目后，霍莉宣布到了吃点心的时间。

sentences.en: Holly would say, you can have this one marshmallow now, or if you want to wait for me to go into the room,
sentences.zh: 霍莉会说，你现在可以吃这颗棉花糖，或者如果你愿意等我走进房间，

sentences.en: if you don't eat this one, you can have two marshmallows instead.
sentences.zh: 如果你不吃这一颗，你就可以得到两颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: And with that premise, that's the classic marshmallow test, she cleared all of the art supplies out of the room
sentences.zh: 在这样的前提下，也就是经典的棉花糖实验，她清理了房间里的所有美术用品，

sentences.en: and left the child alone with the single marshmallow on the table.
sentences.zh: 只留下孩子和桌上孤零零的一颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: And just like in the classic marshmallow test, we measured and waited to see how long they would wait
sentences.zh: 就像在经典的棉花糖实验中一样，我们进行测量并等待，看他们会等多久

sentences.en: before they ate the marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 才会吃掉棉花糖。

sentences.en: And what did you find?
sentences.zh: 你们发现了什么？

sentences.en: We found that there was a big difference between the kids in the unreliable condition versus the reliable condition.
sentences.zh: 我们发现不可靠组的孩子与可靠组的孩子之间存在巨大差异。

sentences.en: In the unreliable condition, kids were much more likely to eat the marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 在不可靠组中，孩子们更有可能吃掉棉花糖。

sentences.en: They waited an average of about three minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们平均只等了大约三分钟。

sentences.en: That's very different from what happened in the reliable condition.
sentences.zh: 这与可靠组的情况截然不同。

sentences.en: In the reliable condition, kids waited four times as long.
sentences.zh: 在可靠组中，孩子们等待的时间是四倍长。

sentences.en: They waited on average 12 minutes before eating the marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 他们在吃掉棉花糖之前平均等待了 12 分钟。

sentences.en: They were less likely to eat the marshmallow in the end in that condition as well.
sentences.zh: 最终，在该组中他们也不太可能吃掉棉花糖。

sentences.en: At one level, you could say the results were entirely unsurprising.
sentences.zh: 从某种层面上讲，可以说这些结果完全意料之中。

sentences.en: If someone tells you to wait five minutes and there will be a wonderful treat at the end,
sentences.zh: 如果有人告诉你等五分钟，最后会有一个美妙的奖赏，

sentences.en: and you wait five minutes only to be told no treat is forthcoming,
sentences.zh: 而你等了五分钟，结果却被告知没有奖赏，

sentences.en: how would you respond if this person told you to wait another five minutes for a new treat?
sentences.zh: 如果这个人再叫你等五分钟去拿新奖赏，你会有什么反应？

sentences.en: You might say something along the lines of,
sentences.zh: 你可能会说类似这样的话：

sentences.en: Fool me once, shame on you.
sentences.zh: 被骗一次，责任在对方。

sentences.en: Fool me twice, shame on me.
sentences.zh: 被骗两次，责任在我方。

sentences.en: It only makes sense to wait for the second marshmallow if you expect the second marshmallow to arrive.
sentences.zh: 只有当你期待第二颗棉花糖到来时，等待它才有意义。

sentences.en: If you don't expect for the second marshmallow to arrive, you should eat the first marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 如果你不期待第二颗棉花糖到来，你就应该吃掉第一颗。

sentences.en: In fact, it would almost be foolish for you not to eat the first marshmallow
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你不吃第一颗棉花糖，几乎可以说是愚蠢的，

sentences.en: because if you don't eat it, someone else might come along and eat it
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不吃，别人可能会过来把它吃掉，

sentences.en: while you're waiting for the second marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 就在你等待第二颗棉花糖的时候。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like the JoJo thing might happen.
sentences.zh: 就像 JoJo 那种事情可能会发生一样。

sentences.en: Like if you don't put the lollipop in your mouth right away,
sentences.zh: 就像如果你不马上把棒棒糖放进嘴里，

sentences.en: somebody else might come along and take it.
sentences.zh: 别人可能会过来拿走它。

sentences.en: So if you think there is no point in waiting for a second.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你认为等待第二颗毫无意义。

sentences.en: You know, I've always wondered what Walter Mischel would make of the way his test has come to be received in the world today, Celeste.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，Celeste，我一直很好奇沃尔特·米歇尔会对他的实验如今在世界上受到的反响作何感想。

sentences.en: I'm not quite sure he anticipated it would take off the way it did
sentences.zh: 我不太确定他是否预料到它会以这种方式火起来，

sentences.en: and that people would draw the implications that they did.
sentences.zh: 并且人们会得出那样的推论。

sentences.en: I mean, at various points he would say, you know, this is a 15-minute teSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在各个节点都会说，你知道的，这是一个 15 分钟的测试。

sentences.en: You can't draw too much into a 15-minute teSt.
sentences.zh: 你不能从一个 15 分钟的测试中得出太多的结论。

sentences.en: Now, he did do the longitudinal studies finding these long-term effects,
sentences.zh: 现在，他确实做了纵向研究，发现了这些长期影响，

sentences.en: but I'm wondering, do you feel like your test has been a corrective not just to the marshmallow test
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，你是否觉得你的实验不仅是对棉花糖实验的一种纠偏，

sentences.en: but the impact, the cultural valence of the marshmallow test in the larger world?
sentences.zh: 也是对棉花糖实验在更广阔世界中的文化价值及影响的一种纠正？

sentences.en: I don't know if I can speak to that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我能否谈论这个。

sentences.en: Walter Mischel was invested in the idea that self-control is an important virtue to develop.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·米歇尔坚信自控力是需要培养的一项重要美德。

sentences.en: That's also largely the point of the book that he wrote about the marshmallow teSt.
sentences.zh: 这也是他所写的关于棉花糖实验的那本书的大致核心。

sentences.en: At the same time, I don't disagree with any of the premises in the original studies.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我并不反对最初研究中的任何前提。

sentences.en: It was inherently acknowledging that children's delaying gratification or not is a flexible system
sentences.zh: 它本质上承认了儿童是否延迟满足是一个灵活的系统，

sentences.en: that can be changed depending upon the attentional strategy that you hand them.
sentences.zh: 可以根据你赋予他们的注意力策略而改变。

sentences.en: So I don't think that work captured the minds of people in the same way
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这项工作并没有像后来

sentences.en: that the promise of the predictive power of the marshmallow test
sentences.zh: 由纵向相关研究所带来的棉花糖实验预测能力的承诺那样，

sentences.en: from the longitudinal correlations did later.
sentences.zh: 深深抓住人们的心。

sentences.en: But Walter Mischel, to my knowledge, wasn't opposed to the idea that the system is flexible.
sentences.zh: 但据我所知，沃尔特·米歇尔并不反对系统是灵活的这一观点。

sentences.en: There are certainly times where delaying gratification pays off.
sentences.zh: 确实有些时候，延迟满足会带来回报。

sentences.en: Work hard and save your money, and you improve your options when it's time to go to college.
sentences.zh: 努力工作并攒下钱，当你准备上大学时，你的选择就会变多。

sentences.en: Study hard today, and you're likely to do better in your exams tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 今天努力学习，你明天考试的成绩很可能会更好。

sentences.en: Tolerate the discomfort that comes with learning a new musical instrument,
sentences.zh: 忍受学习新乐器带来的不适感，

sentences.en: and you might produce beautiful music in a few years.
sentences.zh: 几年后你或许就能弹出美妙的音乐。

sentences.en: Patience and prudence can be virtues.
sentences.zh: 耐心和审慎可以成为美德。

sentences.en: But in the popular understanding of the marshmallow test,
sentences.zh: 但在大众对棉花糖实验的理解中，

sentences.en: many people concluded self-control was a purely personal virtue.
sentences.zh: 许多人断定自控力纯粹是一种个人美德。

sentences.en: You had it, or you didn't have it.
sentences.zh: 你要么有，要么没有。

sentences.en: It was about you, the individual.
sentences.zh: 这完全取决于你个人。

sentences.en: Celeste's reconception of the test underscores that core idea in social psychology.
sentences.zh: Celeste 对该实验的重新构想强调了社会心理学中的那个核心理念。

sentences.en: The context matters.
sentences.zh: 环境很重要。

sentences.en: Self-control is not just about what happens inside our heads.
sentences.zh: 自控力不仅仅关乎我们脑子里发生的事情。

sentences.en: Our capacity for self-control is shaped by whether we live in a safe and predictable world
sentences.zh: 我们控制自控力的能力，取决于我们是生活在一个安全且可预测的世界里，

sentences.en: or a dangerous and unpredictable world.
sentences.zh: 还是一个危险且不可预测的世界里。

sentences.en: Take the kids from the Stanford nursery that Walter Mischel was studying
sentences.zh: 以沃尔特·米歇尔正在研究的斯坦福托儿所的孩子们为例，

sentences.en: and put them in an unpredictable environment for a few weeks,
sentences.zh: 把他们放到一个不可预测的环境中几周，

sentences.en: and they too might behave in ways that would appear impulsive and short-sighted.
sentences.zh: 他们也可能会表现得冲动且目光短浅。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Jacqueline Rifkin is named after her grandfather, Jack.
sentences.zh: 杰奎琳·里夫金是按她的祖父杰克的名字命名的。

sentences.en: We don't know for sure how Jack would have performed on Walter Mischel's marshmallow test,
sentences.zh: 我们不确定杰克在沃尔特·米歇尔的棉花糖实验中表现会如何，

sentences.en: but we can take an educated guess.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以做一个有根据的猜测。

sentences.en: He would not have eaten that first marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 他一定不会吃掉那第一颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: He fought for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他曾为美国

sentences.en: in World War II.
sentences.zh: 参加二战。

sentences.en: He actually helped liberate some of the concentration camps.
sentences.zh: 他实际上参与解放了一些集中营。

sentences.en: And his story, I think, was really instrumental in sort of how I was raised
sentences.zh: 我认为，他的故事对我的成长方式

sentences.en: and how I see the world, even though I never got to meet him.
sentences.zh: 以及我看待世界的方式起到了非常关键的作用，尽管我从未见过他。

sentences.en: So when he got back from the war, he met my grandmother and they got married.
sentences.zh: 所以当他从战争中归来时，他遇到了我的祖母，然后他们结婚了。

sentences.en: And their plan was to be really frugal, save up a lot of money,
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是过得非常节俭，存下很多钱，

sentences.en: be sort of conservative financially.
sentences.zh: 在财务上保持一种保守的态度。

sentences.en: And then when he retired, they would travel the world.
sentences.zh: 然后等他退休后，他们就去环游世界。

sentences.en: And so my mom grew up with this very sort of low-risk, frugal kind of way of living
sentences.zh: 所以我的妈妈在成长过程中，伴随着这种风险很低、非常节俭的生活方式，

sentences.en: with this plan for ultimately my pop-up's retirement.
sentences.zh: 并为我外公最终的退休做好了这种计划。

sentences.en: The sad part of the story is that they never really got to bear the fruits of all of this saving
sentences.zh: 这个故事令人难过的地方在于，他们从未真正享受到所有这些储蓄的成果，

sentences.en: because my pop-up was diagnosed with cancer in his 60s.
sentences.zh: 因为我外公在六十多岁时被诊断出患有癌症。

sentences.en: And he actually passed away just a few months after the diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在确诊几个月后就去世了。

sentences.en: And so my mom sort of told me that over the years, her mom, my mom-mom,
sentences.zh: 所以妈妈告诉我，这些年来，她的母亲（也就是我的外婆）

sentences.en: who lived for many years after that, always kind of regretted the way that they had structured their lives.
sentences.zh: 在之后漫长的岁月中，一直对他们构建生活的方式感到有些遗憾。

sentences.en: And my mom was always really vocal when I was growing up that, you know,
sentences.zh: 在我成长过程中，我妈妈总是直言不讳地说，

sentences.en: obviously responsibility and frugality and prudence are great virtues,
sentences.zh: 责任、节俭和谨慎显然是伟大的美德，

sentences.en: but also not to save everything for later, all of life's pleasures.
sentences.zh: 但也不要把所有生活中的乐趣都留到以后再享受。

sentences.en: It's a lesson that Jacqueline has tried to take to heart.
sentences.zh: 这是杰奎琳一直铭记在心的一个教训。

sentences.en: And yet, despite her mother's warnings and her grandmother's regrets,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管有母亲的警告和祖母的遗憾，

sentences.en: she regularly notices that she is very much her grandfather's granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 她经常发现自己骨子里依然完完全全是个“祖父的孙女”。

sentences.en: So I bought a white blouse from Old Navy several years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以几年前我在Old Navy买了一件白色衬衫。

sentences.en: And if there's something about Old Navy, it's that it's casual and it's not super expensive.
sentences.zh: Old Navy的特点就是休闲而且价格不算太贵。

sentences.en: I think it was probably $19.99.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是19.99美元吧。

sentences.en: And I didn't wear it right away, which is something that I am absolutely kind of a chronic delayer of new clothes.
sentences.zh: 我没有马上穿它，因为我绝对算是一个习惯性拖延穿新衣服的人。

sentences.en: And so I didn't wear it, you know, for school.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我上学时没穿它。

sentences.en: I didn't wear it to run errands.
sentences.zh: 我跑腿办事时也没穿它。

sentences.en: And somehow, over time, it became a date night shirt that I didn't wear.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，随着时间推移，它变成了一件我舍不得穿的约会之夜衬衫。

sentences.en: And then it became a job interview shirt that I didn't wear.
sentences.zh: 后来它又变成了一件我舍不得穿的面试衬衫。

sentences.en: And I think after a few years, the shirt was essentially no longer in style and I just had to donate it.
sentences.zh: 我想几年后，这件衬衫基本上已经过时了，我只能把它捐掉。

sentences.en: And it goes back to zero, right?
sentences.zh: 这就回到了原点，对吧？

sentences.en: The person who buys it, now for them, it's like a workout shirt.
sentences.zh: 买下它的人现在会把它当成运动衫来穿。

sentences.en: But for me, we had gone on this whole journey together where this simple Old Navy shirt had sort of transformed into like a talisman, a fashion talisman.
sentences.zh: 但对我而言，我们曾共同经历过这段旅程，这件简简单单的Old Navy衬衫某种程度上变成了一个护身符，一个时尚护身符。

sentences.en: You've likely experienced some version of this in your own life.
sentences.zh: 你可能在自己的生活中也经历过某种版本的这种事。

sentences.en: If it's not a new shirt hanging in your closet, maybe it's an unused gift card to a local restaurant.
sentences.zh: 如果不是衣橱里挂着的新衬衫，也许是本地餐厅里一张没用过的礼品卡。

sentences.en: Jacqueline is now a marketing professor at Cornell University.
sentences.zh: 杰奎琳现在是康奈尔大学的市场营销学教授。

sentences.en: She and her colleague, Jonah Berger at the University of Pennsylvania, have examined what keeps people from enjoying the things they own.
sentences.zh: 她和宾夕法尼亚大学的同事乔纳·伯杰一起，研究了是什么阻止人们享受自己拥有的东西。

sentences.en: We were really interested in these things that we all own around the house that we like and we're not trying to get rid of, but we're also not using them.
sentences.zh: 我们对屋里拥有的这些东西真的很感兴趣，我们喜欢它们，并不想扔掉它们，但我们也没有在用它们。

sentences.en: So I think a bottle of wine is an example that can resonate with everyone.
sentences.zh: 所以我想一瓶酒就是一个能引起每个人共鸣的例子。

sentences.en: Jonah had socks that he always thought about.
sentences.zh: 乔纳有他总是在惦记着的袜子。

sentences.en: I had a blouse that I always thought about.
sentences.zh: 我有一件总是在惦记着的衬衫。

sentences.en: They were perfectly fine.
sentences.zh: 它们完全没问题。

sentences.en: They weren't special.
sentences.zh: 它们并不特别。

sentences.en: They were kind of just normal.
sentences.zh: 它们只是很普通的那种。

sentences.en: But for some reason, they kept sticking around.
sentences.zh: 但出于某种原因，它们一直留了下来。

sentences.en: We weren't using, but we weren't donating.
sentences.zh: 我们既不用它们，也不捐掉它们。

sentences.en: And so what we found through a series of experiments there was that sometimes people forego usage.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过一系列实验，我们发现有时人们会放弃使用。

sentences.en: They say, I'm not going to open the wine tonight.
sentences.zh: 他们会说：我今晚不打算开这瓶酒。

sentences.en: I'm not going to, you know, bust out the candle and light it for the first time tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚不打算拿出生日蜡烛并第一次点燃它。

sentences.en: And even though it's not our intention, we kind of feel like we're saving it.
sentences.zh: 即使这不是我们的本意，我们也会觉得自己好像是在把它存起来。

sentences.en: So it goes from not now to not now and later.
sentences.zh: 所以它从“现在不”变成了“现在和以后都不”。

sentences.en: And the more that we feel like we're saving, the more special that product becomes.
sentences.zh: 而且我们越是觉得自己在节省，那个产品就变得越特别。

sentences.en: And so we enter this spiral.
sentences.zh: 于是我们陷入了这个螺旋。

sentences.en: We call it a specialness spiral in the paper, whereby people are foregoing usage for something normal.
sentences.zh: 我们在论文中称之为“特别感螺旋”，人们因为某个普通的东西而放弃使用。

sentences.en: It feels a little bit more special.
sentences.zh: 它感觉会变得稍微更特别一点。

sentences.en: So now we want to find a slightly better occasion for it.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们想为它找一个稍微好一点的场合。

sentences.en: So then we forego usage again.
sentences.zh: 于是我们再次放弃使用。

sentences.en: It becomes a little bit more special.
sentences.zh: 它变得更特别了一点。

sentences.en: Okay, now I need to find an even better occasion for it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我需要为它寻找一个更好的场合。

sentences.en: And over time, this perfectly normal pair of socks becomes a treasure that is only worthy for your wedding night.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，这双完全普通的袜子变成了一件只有在你的婚礼之夜才配得上的宝藏。

sentences.en: Notice that the specialness spiral works like a ratchet.
sentences.zh: 注意，特别感螺旋的运作方式就像一个棘轮。

sentences.en: Each time you forego using the shirt, the specialness of the shirt reaches a new threshold.
sentences.zh: 每次你放弃使用这件衬衫，这件衬衫的特别感就会达到一个新的门槛。

sentences.en: The next time you think of using the shirt, the bar is now even higher than it was the last time.
sentences.zh: 下次你想起要穿这件衬衫时，门槛已经比上一次更高了。

sentences.en: That's exactly what happens.
sentences.zh: 这正是所发生的事情。

sentences.en: And we even asked people flat out, you know, what is the right occasion to use this thing?
sentences.zh: 我们甚至直截了当地问过人们，你知道的，使用这东西的合适场合是什么？

sentences.en: And I think the example that we used in that study was just a $10 bottle of wine.
sentences.zh: 我想我们在那项研究中使用的例子只是一瓶10美元的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Nothing special.
sentences.zh: 没什么特别的。

sentences.en: For our folks that had never passed up the opportunity to use it, and we said, when would you use it?
sentences.zh: 对于那些从不错过使用机会的人，我们问：你什么时候会用它？

sentences.en: When works?
sentences.zh: 什么时候合适？

sentences.en: They said, a Tuesday night after dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们说：晚饭后的周二晚上。

sentences.en: Nothing special.
sentences.zh: 没什么特别的。

sentences.en: For the folks that we had had them imagine that they passed it up once or twice, they did ratchet up that threshold.
sentences.zh: 对于那些我们让他们想象自己曾错失过一次或两次机会的人，他们确实抬高了这个门槛。

sentences.en: They said, maybe a Friday, maybe a date.
sentences.zh: 他们说：也许是周五，也许是个约会。

sentences.en: And for the people that had imagined passing it up over and over and over, they were saying,
sentences.zh: 而对于那些想象自己一次又一次错失机会的人，他们会说：

sentences.en: rehearsal dinner, 50th wedding anniversary, the moment I land my dream job.
sentences.zh: 彩排晚宴、结婚50周年纪念日、我得到梦想工作的那一刻。

sentences.en: They were ratcheting up this threshold of something that was always a $10 bottle of wine, but in their mind,
sentences.zh: 他们一直在不断抬高这个门槛，对待一个本来永远只是一瓶10美元的酒的东西，但在他们心里，

sentences.en: it had sort of been accruing and accruing and specialness to the point where, when is that perfect night?
sentences.zh: 它一直在不断累积着特别感，直到——什么时候才是那个完美的夜晚？

sentences.en: How many of us do see our 50th wedding anniversary?
sentences.zh: 我们当中有多少人能亲眼见证我们的结婚50周年纪念日呢？

sentences.en: Now we're dreaming of an occasion that maybe most people don't even get to experience.
sentences.zh: 现在我们梦想着一个也许大多数人甚至都无法经历的场合。

sentences.en: Call this, if you will, the reverse marshmallow teSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，可以称之为“反向棉花糖实验”。

sentences.en: The challenge here is not in resisting temptation, but in having the ability to indulge in everyday pleasures.
sentences.zh: 这里的挑战不在于抵制诱惑，而在于是否有能力纵情享受日常的快乐。

sentences.en: Another example from Jacqueline's life is a time she went on vacation and decided to bring home some spices as a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 杰奎琳生活中的另一个例子是，她有一次去度假，决定带回一些香料作为纪念品。

sentences.en: And it's not a very long story because I never used the spices.
sentences.zh: 这个故事并不长，因为我从来没用过那些香料。

sentences.en: I brought them with me from move to move.
sentences.zh: 我带着它们从一个住处搬到另一个住处。

sentences.en: They were always there.
sentences.zh: 它们总是在那儿。

sentences.en: They took up space in my cabinet.
sentences.zh: 它们占用了我橱柜里的空间。

sentences.en: And it ultimately got to the point where I had to Google, when do spices go bad?
sentences.zh: 最终发展到我不得不去谷歌搜索：香料什么时候会过期？

sentences.en: And to the point where those spices were almost definitely bad.
sentences.zh: 甚至到了那些香料几乎肯定已经坏了的地步。

sentences.en: And so they just sort of became a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 所以它们不知不觉就变成了纯粹的纪念品。

sentences.en: They weren't really functioning as spices anymore.
sentences.zh: 它们不再真正发挥香料的作用了。

sentences.en: I wasn't really getting out of them what I should have been by, you know, putting them in my food and enjoying them with loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我并没有真正从中得到我本该获得的东西，比如把它们放进食物里并和所爱的人一起享受它们。

sentences.en: What Jacqueline is saying is that if some people have trouble with being impulsive, others have a problem with giving themselves permission to be indulgent.
sentences.zh: 杰奎琳的意思是，如果有些人难以克服冲动，另一些人则在允许自己放纵方面存在问题。

sentences.en: I think the typical way that we like to think of ourselves is almost as sort of impulse-laden hedons.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们通常看待自己的方式，几乎就像是充满冲动的享乐主义者。

sentences.en: We see a candy bar and we can't stop ourselves from taking it.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一块糖果就忍不住要拿来吃。

sentences.en: Or we have the opportunity to play hooky from work and do something irresponsible and we just take it.
sentences.zh: 或者我们有机会翘班去做一些不负责任的事情，然后我们就真的去了。

sentences.en: We can't stop ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们无法克制自己。

sentences.en: So there's incredible work from Anat Kinan and Ron Kivitz.
sentences.zh: 因此，安娜·基南和罗恩·基维茨做过极其出色的研究。

sentences.en: They sort of challenge that assumption and think, well, maybe instead of being these sort of impulsive hedons, a lot of us are actually too controlled.
sentences.zh: 他们某种程度上挑战了那种假设，并认为：嗯，也许我们许多人并没有成为那种冲动的享乐主义者，反而是受到了过度的控制。

sentences.en: A lot of us are too serious and afraid of indulging.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人过于严肃，害怕纵情享受。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of us that don't take any time off, let alone playing hooky from work,
sentences.zh: 所以我们当中有很多人根本不休假，更不用说从工作中翘班了，

sentences.en: where we're so fixated on being virtuous and being good and staying true to our values and self-control that we actually don't indulge nearly as much as we should.
sentences.zh: 我们如此执着于保持美德、表现良好、忠于我们的价值观和自我控制，以至于我们实际上并没有像本该做的那样尽情享受生活。

sentences.en: Can you talk about one challenge with the specialness spiral, which is we want to wait for the perfect moment to use something, the bottle of wine, the expensive spices,
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈特别感螺旋带来的一个挑战吗？那就是我们总是想等待完美的时刻来使用某样东西，比如那瓶酒、昂贵的香料，

sentences.en: but we don't quite know exactly when that moment's going to arrive.
sentences.zh: 但我们并不太清楚那个时刻究竟什么时候会到来。

sentences.en: We tell ourselves, when that moment arrives, I'll know it.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉自己：当那个时刻到来时，我会知道的。

sentences.en: But in fact, at every given moment we say, is this the moment?
sentences.zh: 但事实上，在每一个给定的时刻，我们都在问：这是那个时刻吗？

sentences.en: And we say, no, not quite.
sentences.zh: 然后我们说：不，还差得远。

sentences.en: That's exactly what happens.
sentences.zh: 这正是所发生的事情。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of research on what's called sequential search, which is in contrast to simultaneous search.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多关于所谓“顺序搜索”的研究，这与“同时搜索”形成对比。

sentences.en: So simultaneous is when all the options are in front of you.
sentences.zh: 所谓同时搜索，就是所有的选项都摆在你的面前。

sentences.en: You've got your five flavors of jam in front of you.
sentences.zh: 你的五种口味果酱就摆在你面前。

sentences.en: You can see them all.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它们看个真切。

sentences.en: And so you pick one.
sentences.zh: 然后你挑选其中一个。

sentences.en: Sequential search, on the other hand, is if each jam was presented to you one by one.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，顺序搜索是指如果每个果酱都是逐一呈现在你面前。

sentences.en: And so even though it's the same jams, the decision becomes a lot harder because you can only evaluate one at a time.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管是同样的果酱，决策过程却变得困难得多，因为你一次只能评估一个。

sentences.en: And maybe you don't know what's coming next.
sentences.zh: 而且也许你不知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: You probably can't go back and get one that you already passed on.
sentences.zh: 你可能无法回头再去拿一个你已经错过的果酱。

sentences.en: You can't really evaluate all of your options at once.
sentences.zh: 你根本无法同时评估所有的选项。

sentences.en: It's just not possible.
sentences.zh: 这简直是不可能的。

sentences.en: And jam is a mundane example, but there's really big, meaty versions of this decision that we all deal with.
sentences.zh: 果酱是一个世俗的例子，但我们所有人都要面对这种决策的重大、实质性的版本。

sentences.en: Who do you marry?
sentences.zh: 你和谁结婚？

sentences.en: Who do you hire?
sentences.zh: 你雇佣谁？

sentences.en: Or you can really only evaluate one of these things at a time.
sentences.zh: 或者你真的每次只能评估其中一件事。

sentences.en: And so what the research suggests is that when we're having options presented to us one at a time, it's hard to compare, right?
sentences.zh: 所以研究表明，当选项是一个接一个地呈现在我们面前时，很难进行比较，对吧？

sentences.en: You don't have all those jams in front of you.
sentences.zh: 你并没有把所有的果酱都摆在面前。

sentences.en: And so what a lot of us do is we come up with a reference point in our mind of, well, what would the best jam be?
sentences.zh: 因此，我们很多人所做的就是在脑海中建立一个参考点，比如：最好的果酱会是什么样的？

sentences.en: And that jam may not even exiSt.
sentences.zh: 而那种果酱可能根本就不存在。

sentences.en: We come up with this sort of idealized, aspirational, perfect match.
sentences.zh: 我们想出了这种理想化、令人向往的完美匹配。

sentences.en: And now we're comparing every option against that ideal.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正拿每一个选项去和那个理想进行对比。

sentences.en: And so it becomes really hard to pull the trigger because we're comparing against this perfect, potentially unmeetable ideal.
sentences.zh: 因此很难痛快下决定，因为我们是在和一个完美的、可能无法满足的理想进行对比。

sentences.en: When we do pull the trigger, we may feel disappointed.
sentences.zh: 当我们真的下了决定时，我们可能会感到失望。

sentences.en: We may pull the trigger much later than we ought to because we're stuck into this, you know, when I see the ideal person, I'll know.
sentences.zh: 我们做出决定的时间可能比应有的要晚得多，因为我们陷入了这种思维：嗯，当我看到理想的人时，我就会知道。

sentences.en: Or when I see the ideal job candidate, I'll feel it.
sentences.zh: 或者当我看到理想的求职候选人时，我就会有感觉。

sentences.en: And it creates a lot of complications in decision-making that ultimately lead to not only poor quality decisions, but less happy people.
sentences.zh: 它在决策过程中制造了许多复杂情况，最终不仅导致了低质量的决策，还让人不那么幸福。

sentences.en: So you're not necessarily saying that the ability to save for your retirement or the ability to, you know, exercise or eat the right diet or, you know, the ability to say,
sentences.zh: 所以你并不是必然在说，为退休存钱的能力，或者，你知道的，锻炼或保持正确饮食的能力，或者，你知道的，这种能力——

sentences.en: I'm going to quit smoking today, even though it gives me pleasure today.
sentences.zh: 我要在今天戒烟，尽管它今天能给我带来快乐。

sentences.en: Because, in fact, 20 years from now, my health is going to be better, you're not necessarily saying those are bad things.
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，从今往后的20年里，我的健康状况会更好，你并不是必然在说这些是坏事。

sentences.en: You're not saying that deferring gratification is always a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 你并不是说延迟满足总是坏事。

sentences.en: You're just saying sometimes it can be a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 你只是说有时它可能会是一件坏事。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So I, by no means, is delaying gratification a bad thing to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，我绝不是说延迟满足是一件坏事。

sentences.en: And especially when it comes to pursuits that we're doing for our own health and trying to make sure that we're setting ourselves up for success in the future,
sentences.zh: 尤其是当我们追求为了自身健康、并试图确保为未来的成功打下基础的事情时，

sentences.en: financially or physically.
sentences.zh: 无论是财务上还是身体上。

sentences.en: That's all great stuff to be doing and things that I work on and I think everybody should work on.
sentences.zh: 这些都是非常棒的事情，也是我在努力去做、并且我认为每个人都应该去努力的事情。

sentences.en: My fear comes in where that becomes the only mode of behaving and at the cost of doing things in the moment for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我担忧的是，当这种状态成为唯一的行为模式，并且以牺牲当下为自己做事情为代价时。

sentences.en: We have to start to retrain ourselves to seek out things that make us happy, not necessarily negative things like smoking, but just just a moment out in nature, journaling,
sentences.zh: 我们必须开始重新训练自己去寻找能让我们快乐的事物，不一定是像抽烟那样消极的事物，而只是在自然中待一会儿、写日记、

sentences.en: having a really nice conversation.
sentences.zh: 进行一次非常愉快的交谈。

sentences.en: Healthy things that are really just for us and not for our future self and not for anybody else.
sentences.zh: 那些真正只属于我们当下、而不是为了未来的自己、也不是为了其他任何人的健康事物。
